features.name: RAF control tower
features.anchor_role: public HER representative point, not entrance or building footprint
features.research_note: A modified wartime watch office, used until the civil tower replaced it in 1999. Model its chosen historic phase separately from later additions.
features.proposed_museum_treatment: Restore the wartime exterior where supported; interpret later changes indoors.
features.review_status: reviewed for concept; survey geometry pending

features.name: Battle Headquarters
features.anchor_role: public HER representative point, not entrance or building footprint
features.research_note: HER maps a likely HQ surface structure as demolished in 2021. A 2009 Subterranea Britannica visit describes rooms, an unusually tall cupola and a ladder. These observations do not establish the present buried condition.
features.proposed_museum_treatment: Evidence-labelled reconstruction candidate beside the old tower; no invented connected tunnels.
features.review_status: reviewed for concept; survey geometry pending

features.name: Civilian control tower
features.anchor_role: public HER representative point, not entrance or building footprint
features.survival_as_recorded: described in 2016 survey; current condition unverified
features.research_note: The civilian tower was built in 1999 over a pyrotechnic store believed to date from USAF use. Store dimensions and internal arrangement are not established.
features.proposed_museum_treatment: Retain as the postwar/civil aviation lookout; store only as an unmodelled evidence marker.
features.review_status: reviewed for concept; survey geometry pending

features.name: T2 hangar
features.anchor_role: public HER representative point, not entrance or building footprint
features.research_note: The 1980s rebuilding retained the original steel frame; later cladding and other fabric should not be presented as original wartime material.
features.proposed_museum_treatment: Main aircraft and conservation hall; retain the building in its actual location.
features.review_status: reviewed for concept; survey geometry pending

features.name: E-type fighter pen
features.anchor_role: public HER representative point, not entrance or building footprint
features.research_note: A surviving part of a fighter pen with an associated revetted slit trench; the trench was mapped as levelled. The footprint includes the earthwork setting.
features.proposed_museum_treatment: Restore missing arms selectively and label additions; aircraft and ground-crew exhibit.
features.review_status: reviewed for concept; survey geometry pending

features.name: Alland Grange sunken hangar
features.anchor_role: public HER representative point, not entrance or building footprint
features.survival_as_recorded: banks survived in 2021; walls recorded demolished
features.research_note: The hangar occupied a chalk excavation with a ramp, retaining structures and frame supports. The cited KCC account says soil covering was not intended.
features.proposed_museum_treatment: Flagship partial reconstruction with visible chalk cut and interpreted roof/frame; dimensions await plan registration.
features.review_status: reviewed for concept; survey geometry pending

features.name: Cheeseman sunken hangar
features.anchor_role: public HER representative point, not entrance or building footprint
features.research_note: Aerial evidence distinguishes this hangar from nearby earlier earthworks. Later military features occupied the site.
features.proposed_museum_treatment: Outline and archaeological garden; restore only if surviving-landscape conflicts are resolved.
features.review_status: reviewed for concept; survey geometry pending

features.name: Northern hangar excavation
features.anchor_role: public HER representative point, not entrance or building footprint
features.research_note: Two spoil banks and an approach from Manston Road were mapped. Completion and roofing are not established.
features.proposed_museum_treatment: Show the unfinished project through earthwork outlines, not a finished hangar.
features.review_status: reviewed for concept; survey geometry pending

features.name: Opposite unfinished hangar
features.anchor_role: public HER representative point, not entrance or building footprint
features.research_note: Initial pits and spoil were mapped opposite the other northern excavation. This was not a completed underground building.
features.proposed_museum_treatment: Companion landscape interpretation; no walkable interior.
features.review_status: reviewed for concept; survey geometry pending

features.name: Surveyed chalk air-raid shelter
features.anchor_role: public HER representative point, not entrance or building footprint
features.survival_as_recorded: surveyed after rediscovery in 2004; present state unknown
features.research_note: KURG surveyed a single chalk passage with an entrance at each end, 1.3 m wide; HER gives a 1.8-2 m depth dimension. Length, bearing, overburden and exact portals are absent from the public record.
features.proposed_museum_treatment: Place an approximate evidence marker. Prototype an explicitly interpretive interior separately until the original survey is obtained.
features.review_status: reviewed for concept; survey geometry pending

features.name: Western technical-site shelters
features.anchor_role: public HER representative point, not entrance or building footprint
features.research_note: Fifteen separate shelter earthworks flanked former hangars/workshops. At least two had revetted slit-trench approaches.
features.proposed_museum_treatment: Select one representative exhibit after acquiring geometry; use ground traces for others.
features.review_status: reviewed for concept; survey geometry pending

features.name: Northern station shelters

features.name: FIDO tanks and pump houses
features.anchor_role: public HER representative point, not entrance or building footprint
features.research_note: Four bunded tanks and two pump houses supplied the fog-dispersal installation. HADES conversion was finished in May 1945; later operation was under trial conditions.
features.proposed_museum_treatment: Reconstruct selected tank/bund outlines and a non-burning interpretation display.
features.review_status: reviewed for concept; survey geometry pending

features.name: FIDO pipe trenches
features.anchor_role: public HER representative point, not entrance or building footprint
features.research_note: Mapped trench fragments identify fuel-line installation around the eastern runway and approach. They do not demonstrate a passage people could walk through.
features.proposed_museum_treatment: Subsurface service overlay only.
features.review_status: reviewed for concept; survey geometry pending

features.name: FIDO control chamber
features.anchor_role: public HER representative point, not entrance or building footprint
features.research_note: A small control building is identified on RAF Museum plan X004-2380. The word chamber does not establish a bunker below ground.
features.proposed_museum_treatment: Small reconstructed control exhibit if the original plan supports dimensions.

features.name: FIDO workshop and office
features.anchor_role: public HER representative point, not entrance or building footprint
features.research_note: The FIDO facility included a repair shop, office hut and staff ablutions.
features.proposed_museum_treatment: Small support ensemble or outlines on the long runway trail.

features.name: FIDO supply from Abbey Farm
features.anchor_role: public HER representative point, not entrance or building footprint
features.survival_as_recorded: route mapped; some building survival uncertain
features.research_note: A six-inch fuel main connected railway-side facilities to the tanks. Its HER point represents a long feature extent, not a building or portal.
features.proposed_museum_treatment: Regional context overlay; do not turn the pipeline into a tunnel.

features.name: Southern service trenches
features.anchor_role: public HER representative point, not entrance or building footprint
features.research_note: Long trenches parallel to the south of the crash runway are interpreted as services. Their detailed purpose and construction are not established.

features.name: Alland Grange reported tunnels
features.anchor_role: public HER representative point, not entrance or building footprint
features.research_note: A 2015 verbal account links tunnels to an Auxiliary Units wireless role and says much was lost to later works. The record distinguishes these from other nearby air-raid tunnels.
features.proposed_museum_treatment: Regional interpretation marker only; no connection to the sunken hangar or airfield shelter is evidenced.
features.review_status: reviewed for concept; survey geometry pending

features.name: Crash runway and salvage bays
features.anchor_role: public HER representative point, not entrance or building footprint
features.survival_as_recorded: historic runway transformed by later airport use
features.research_note: The wartime emergency landing layout preceded later resurfacing and modern runway markings. HER extent dimensions cover mapped features and are not pavement width.
features.proposed_museum_treatment: Keep modern surveyed runway scale; reveal historic emergency-landing layout in a dated overlay.
features.review_status: reviewed for concept; survey geometry pending

features.name: Camp railway terminus
features.anchor_role: public HER representative point, not entrance or building footprint
features.research_note: A platform served the camp railway from the Birchington/Minnis Bay connection. The public HER centre and extent do not define the platform edges.
features.proposed_museum_treatment: Restore a short platform/track exhibit after plan registration; regional route shown separately.
features.review_status: reviewed for concept; survey geometry pending
